Don_Incident.text: The Situation at the Time of the Incident
Don_Incident.label: Talk_Don_Incident_Init

Dressing_Room_Start.text: {bg:DressingRoom}{startBGM:investigation}{topicUnlock:Don_Yumi}{topicUnlock:Don_Incident}{topicUnlock:Don_Mareka}{topicUnlock:Don_Costume}{skip:0}{sectionEnd}

Dressing_Room_Start.name: Don
Dressing_Room_Start.text: {hideTextbox}{sprite:Don["Normal"]}{hideCharacter}{fadeInCharacter:300}{showTextbox}{blip:1}(Hmm...)

Dressing_Room_Start.name: Phoenix
Dressing_Room_Start.text: {blip:0,false}{color:lightblue}(On television, he's always so arrogant... but...){color:white}

Dressing_Room_Start.name: Phoenix
Dressing_Room_Start.text: {blip:0,false}{color:lightblue}(He's exactly the same in person as he is on TV.){color:white}

Dressing_Room_Start.name: Phoenix
Dressing_Room_Start.text: {blip:0,true}{color:white}I'm Phoenix Wright, attorney at law. Is Mr. Don available?

Dressing_Room_Start.name: Phoenix
Dressing_Room_Start.text: {blip:0,false}{color:lightblue}(Wow... he's really big...){color:white}

Dressing_Room_Start.name: Don
Dressing_Room_Start.text: {blip:1}Ah, welcome! So you're Phoenix Wright. I've heard the rumors.

Dressing_Room_Start.name: Don
Dressing_Room_Start.text: They say you believe your clients are innocent, and no matter how cornered you become, you manage to turn things around.

Dressing_Room_Start.name: Don
Dressing_Room_Start.text: {sprite:Don["Smiling"]}Quite the capable attorney, I'd say.

Dressing_Room_Start.name: Phoenix
Dressing_Room_Start.text: {blip:0,false}{color:lightblue}(In person, he has even more presence than on TV...)

Dressing_Room_Start.name: Phoenix
Dressing_Room_Start.text: {color:lightblue}(I didn't realize I had such a good reputation. All this hard work has paid off...){color:white}

Dressing_Room_Start.name: Don
Dressing_Room_Start.text: {sprite:Don["Smiling"]}{blip:1}It's only natural. It's understandable that Edgeworth holds you in high regard.

Dressing_Room_Start.name: Phoenix
Dressing_Room_Start.text: {blip:0,false}{color:lightblue}(Entertainment industry and the legal world... I wouldn't think they'd overlap, but he seems well-informed.){color:white}

Dressing_Room_Start.name: Don
Dressing_Room_Start.text: {sprite:Don["Normal"]}{blip:1}So you're the defense attorney this time, and Edgeworth is the prosecutor.

Dressing_Room_Start.name: Don
Dressing_Room_Start.text: Well then, not a bad lineup at all.

Dressing_Room_Start.name: Phoenix
Dressing_Room_Start.text: {blip:0,true}{color:white}You know Edgeworth as well?

Dressing_Room_Start.name: Don
Dressing_Room_Start.text: {blip:1}I'm the don of the entertainment industry.

Dressing_Room_Start.name: Don
Dressing_Room_Start.text: The police and legal world are no exception.

Dressing_Room_Start.name: Don
Dressing_Room_Start.text: I'm a busy man. If you're here to listen to my account, then let's begin.

Dressing_Room_Start.name: Phoenix
Dressing_Room_Start.text: {blip:0,false}{color:lightblue}(Alright, what should I ask about...){color:white}{topicUnlock:Don_Yumi}{topicUnlock:Don_Incident}{topicUnlock:Don_Mareka}{topicUnlock:Don_Costume}{sectionEnd}

Talk_Don_Yumi_Intro.name: Don
Talk_Don_Yumi_Intro.text: {hideTextbox}{sprite:Don["Normal"]}{hideCharacter}{fadeInCharacter}{showTextbox}{blip:1}Yumi was one of Japan's top actresses, blessed with wealth, status, and honor.

Talk_Don_Yumi_Intro.name: Don
Talk_Don_Yumi_Intro.text: She also served as a board member of this amusement park alongside me.

Talk_Don_Yumi_Intro.name: Don
Talk_Don_Yumi_Intro.text: {blip:1}However, Yumi's terrible personality was equally top-tier.

Talk_Don_Yumi_Intro.name: Don
Talk_Don_Yumi_Intro.text: Her hobby was spreading rumors, and she enjoyed watching others fall from heaven to hell.

Talk_Don_Yumi_Intro.name: Don
Talk_Don_Yumi_Intro.text: Recently, she'd been spreading all sorts of rumors about Mareka, who was rising in popularity.

Talk_Don_Yumi_Repeat.name: Don
Talk_Don_Yumi_Repeat.text: {hideTextbox}{sprite:Don["Normal"]}{hideCharacter}{fadeInCharacter}{showTextbox}{blip:1}Yumi's bad reputation was endless. She had accumulated quite a bit of karma.{sectionEnd}

Talk_Don_Incident_Intro.name: Don
Talk_Don_Incident_Intro.text: {hideTextbox}{sprite:Don["Normal"]}{hideCharacter}{fadeInCharacter}{showTextbox}{blip:1}At the time of the incident, I was watching Mareka and Yumi's rehearsal from beside the ring.

Talk_Don_Incident_Intro.name: Don
Talk_Don_Incident_Intro.text: Neither of them seemed to notice I was there.

Talk_Don_Incident_Intro.name: Don
Talk_Don_Incident_Intro.text: Those present around the ring at the time were...

Talk_Don_Incident_Intro.name: Don
Talk_Don_Incident_Intro.text: Just the three of us.

Talk_Don_Incident_Intro.name: Don
Talk_Don_Incident_Intro.text: It was around 7:51 when it happened, right after the rehearsal began.

Talk_Don_Incident_Intro.name: Don
Talk_Don_Incident_Intro.text: Mareka struck Yumi on the head with a vase and then left the cage using a wire.

Talk_Don_Incident_Intro.name: Don
Talk_Don_Incident_Intro.text: According to the script, the vase should have broken with a light sound.

Talk_Don_Incident_Intro.name: Don
Talk_Don_Incident_Intro.text: When Yumi saw this, she would realize that Mareka was her long-lost sister,

Talk_Don_Incident_Intro.name: Don
Talk_Don_Incident_Intro.text: and then they would begin an emotional fight scene with tears of joy.

Talk_Don_Incident_Intro.name: Phoenix
Talk_Don_Incident_Intro.text: {blip:0,false}{color:lightblue}(What exactly are you saying...?){color:white}

Talk_Don_Incident_Intro.name: Don
Talk_Don_Incident_Intro.text: {sprite:Don["PeekGlasses"]}The vase that Mareka swung made a dull thud and took Yumi's life.

Talk_Don_Incident_Intro.name: Don
Talk_Don_Incident_Intro.text: {sprite:Don["Normal"]}When I peered through the cage, Yumi lay motionless.

Talk_Don_Incident_Intro.name: Don
Talk_Don_Incident_Intro.text: A broken vase lay beside her.

Talk_Don_Incident_Intro.name: Don
Talk_Don_Incident_Intro.text: Mareka must have prepared a real vase beforehand and intended to kill her during the rehearsal.

Talk_Don_Incident_Intro.name: Phoenix
Talk_Don_Incident_Intro.text: {blip:0,true}{color:white}Wait a moment. That contradicts Mareka's testimony...

Talk_Don_Incident_Intro.name: Don
Talk_Don_Incident_Intro.text: {hideTextbox}{sprite:Don["FixGlasses"]}{hideCharacter}{flash}{fadeInCharacter}{showTextbox}{blip:1}Glare!

Talk_Don_Incident_Intro.name: Don
Talk_Don_Incident_Intro.text: Are you saying you don't believe my account?

Talk_Don_Incident_Intro.name: Phoenix
Talk_Don_Incident_Intro.text: {blip:0,true}{color:white}N-No, that's not what I mean...

Talk_Don_Incident_Intro.name: Phoenix
Talk_Don_Incident_Intro.text: I understand. Please, continue with your account.

Talk_Don_Incident_Intro.name: Don
Talk_Don_Incident_Intro.text: {sprite:Don["Normal"]}{blip:1}I left the venue to call the police. Then I reunited with Mareka and the ambulance crew.

Talk_Don_Incident_Intro.name: Phoenix
Talk_Don_Incident_Intro.text: {blip:0,true}{color:white}Mareka called the ambulance?

Talk_Don_Incident_Intro.name: Don
Talk_Don_Incident_Intro.text: {blip:1}Yes. I suppose it was a cover-up attempt.

Talk_Don_Incident_Intro.name: Don
Talk_Don_Incident_Intro.text: I questioned her right there. Why did she do this...?

Talk_Don_Incident_Intro.name: Don
Talk_Don_Incident_Intro.text: Then she told such an obvious lie—that she'd hit her with a prop vase.

Talk_Don_Incident_Intro.name: Don
Talk_Don_Incident_Intro.text: A real vase and a prop vase have different weights. She couldn't possibly have confused them.

Talk_Don_Incident_Intro.name: Don
Talk_Don_Incident_Intro.text: {sprite:Don["PeekGlasses"]}In other words, it was intentional murder.

Talk_Don_Incident_Intro.name: Phoenix
Talk_Don_Incident_Intro.text: {blip:0,false}{color:lightblue}(Alright, what should I ask about...){color:white}{setState:talked_don_incident,true}{jump:Talk_Don_Check}{sectionEnd}

Talk_Don_Incident_Repeat.name: Don
Talk_Don_Incident_Repeat.text: {hideTextbox}{sprite:Don["Normal"]}{hideCharacter}{fadeInCharacter}{showTextbox}{blip:1}Mareka intentionally prepared a real vase. That much is certain.{sectionEnd}

Talk_Don_Mareka_Intro.name: Don
Talk_Don_Mareka_Intro.text: {hideTextbox}{sprite:Don["Normal"]}{hideCharacter}{fadeInCharacter}{showTextbox}{blip:1}I first met Mareka at a small theater on the weekend. It was her stage debut.

Talk_Don_Mareka_Intro.name: Don
Talk_Don_Mareka_Intro.text: Watching her performance, I knew immediately. This woman would conquer the world.

Talk_Don_Mareka_Intro.name: Don
Talk_Don_Mareka_Intro.text: {sprite:Don["Smiling"]}{blip:1}Of course. I am the don of the entertainment industry.

Talk_Don_Mareka_Intro.name: Don
Talk_Don_Mareka_Intro.text: {sprite:Don["Normal"]}I saw her talent and scouted her myself, and yet...

Talk_Don_Mareka_Intro.name: Don
Talk_Don_Mareka_Intro.text: Mareka threw it all away. Such a foolish woman.

Talk_Don_Mareka_Repeat.name: Don
Talk_Don_Mareka_Repeat.text: {hideTextbox}{sprite:Don["Normal"]}{hideCharacter}{fadeInCharacter}{showTextbox}{blip:1}I've lost all faith in Mareka. That's all there is to it.{sectionEnd}

Talk_Don_Costume_Intro.name: Phoenix
Talk_Don_Costume_Intro.text: {hideTextbox}{sprite:Don["Normal"]}{hideCharacter}{fadeInCharacter}{showTextbox}{blip:0,true}{color:white}There are multiple copies of that costume. Are those from the stage production?

Talk_Don_Costume_Intro.name: Don
Talk_Don_Costume_Intro.text: {blip:1}Costumes get torn and stained. So we have several identical copies.

Talk_Don_Costume_Intro.name: Phoenix
Talk_Don_Costume_Intro.text: {blip:0,false}{color:lightblue}(If one was being worn during the performance... then what happened to the other one...?)}

Talk_Don_Costume_Intro.name: Phoenix
Talk_Don_Costume_Intro.text: {color:lightblue}(That's strange. I should make a note of this.){p:300}{flash}{playSound:cling}{color:white}{addEvidence:MissingCostume}{showEvidenceIcon:right,MissingCostume}{p:1500}{hideEvidenceIcon}{setState:talked_don_costume,true}{jump:Talk_Don_Check}{sectionEnd}

Talk_Don_Costume_Repeat.name: Don
Talk_Don_Costume_Repeat.text: {hideTextbox}{sprite:Don["Normal"]}{hideCharacter}{fadeInCharacter}{showTextbox}{blip:1}If you want to know about costumes, ask the stage manager.{sectionEnd}

Dressing_Room_Complete.name: Don
Dressing_Room_Complete.text: {hideTextbox}{sprite:Don["Normal"]}{hideCharacter}{fadeInCharacter}{showTextbox}{blip:1}I think that's enough. I'm a busy man.

Dressing_Room_Complete.name: Don
Dressing_Room_Complete.text: {sprite:Don["Smiling"]}{blip:1}Phoenix, I'm counting on you. Make tomorrow's trial a good one.

Dressing_Room_Complete.name: Phoenix
Dressing_Room_Complete.text: {blip:0,false}{color:lightblue}(But Don testified that Mareka committed murder...)

Dressing_Room_Complete.name: Phoenix
Dressing_Room_Complete.text: {color:lightblue}(So why does he expect me, Mareka's defense attorney, to do well?)

Dressing_Room_Complete.name: Don
Dressing_Room_Complete.text: {sprite:Don["Normal"]}{blip:1}Oh yes. And watch out for the paint.

Dressing_Room_Complete.name: Don
Dressing_Room_Complete.text: {blip:1}A stagehand named Usaki is making a sign somewhere,

Dressing_Room_Complete.name: Don
Dressing_Room_Complete.text: and he's been putting an unusual amount of effort into it.

Dressing_Room_Complete.name: Don
Dressing_Room_Complete.text: He bought special acrylic paint and has been trying to create an original marbled color for the past few days.

Dressing_Room_Complete.name: Don
Dressing_Room_Complete.text: That special paint takes a long time to dry. Don't touch it if you find it.

Dressing_Room_Complete.name: Phoenix
Dressing_Room_Complete.text: {blip:0,true}{color:white}I understand. I'll be careful. Thank you.

Dressing_Room_Complete.name: Phoenix
Dressing_Room_Complete.text: {blip:0,false}{color:lightblue}(I think I've gathered all the information I needed.)

Dressing_Room_Complete.name: Phoenix
Dressing_Room_Complete.text: {color:lightblue}(Once I have all the pieces together, I'll head to the courtroom and reveal the truth!)
